decisions.reason: Report explicitly distinguishes clipboardText projection (chip expands to clipboardText, Occurrence offsets) from detectText (chip = one U+FFFC) used by insertReference/consumeToken splices, citing both fixture files with a table and noting plain text/spaces contribute normal width.

Locates start/end = snapshot.draft.length in plugin-client.js add, explains paste #1 coincidence on empty composer (0==0) and paste #2 overflow of the 2-char detect text causing insertReference false and the changed-composer toast; explicitly rules out stale draftRev and treats the toast as misleading, not a concurrent edit; no invented inconsistent counts.

Traces remove passing unconverted occurrence.offset/length to consumeToken, ignoring the false return, deleting records anyway; ties both 'unavailable' dock rendering and surviving composer chip to the same coordinate mismatch rather than an upload failure, quoting the capture line.

Derives detect(O) = O - Σ(length-1) for preceding occurrences, applies it at both call sites with concrete code; insertion uses all occurrences for end-of-draft, removal maps offset then uses a 1-char span; keeps draftRev guard from same snapshot; gates records.delete on successful consumeToken return.

Proposes two successive pastes with both chips present, then removing a chip that has a preceding chip, asserting occurrence/dock chip/record removed together while the other chip survives; adds empty-again, CAS, phase-guard, and mid-document variants.
